indicator.name: Households owning a car
indicator.description: Percentage of conventional households owning a car in KNBS 2019 KPHC Volume IV Table 2.36.
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published directly for all 47 counties. This is household car ownership, not an administrative vehicle-registration count or vehicles per capita. It is non-directional and excluded from ranking. No combined vehicle-ownership total is inferred.
